text:
My first visit wasn't very impressive.
The doctor was incredibly lovely, giving great advice, having a gentle touch, and being very pleasant to talk to. However, the staff were very inattentive. They didn't do things that needed to be done beforehand to gather information for comparison. When the doctor asked the staff to prepare the 1234 form for the client, they just did it hastily and carelessly, as if they weren't interested. They were constantly on their phones, offering no assistance, and didn't respond to any requests. This happened throughout the entire process—walking me up to the doctor's room, inside the room, and even downstairs to record the information. They were still on their phones the whole time. They didn't answer much of what I said and seemed tired and bored, even though there were three of them.
